## Overview

- **Name**: MRP Subcontracting
- **Description**: Manages outsourced manufacturing workflows: component shipment to subcontractors, finished goods reception, resupply automation, and BOM subcontracting workflows
- **Location**: addons/mrp_subcontracting — 2 root files
- **Language**: Python (Odoo ORM), JavaScript (portal UI)
- **Purpose**: Enables manufacturing companies to outsource production runs: sends components to subcontractors, receives finished goods, tracks resupply, and manages subcontracting BOMs and routes
